body:
Hi Alizabeth,

Starting a cleaning company takes guts, so fair play. But right now your whole web presence is one single page, and the only proof on it is one Facebook review, presented as your very first. There are no service pages, no Google rating to show and no address, so anyone in Surprise or Peoria checking you out learns almost nothing and moves on.

New companies need trust fast, and a one page site cannot carry that on its own.

So I went ahead and redesigned the homepage for you, and it is attached to this email as a PDF. Your five services each get their own clear section, the booking steps are laid out in three simple steps, and your first five-star review sits where a first-time customer can actually see it and feel confident booking.

I build websites for cleaning companies. LA Clean (lacleanco.com) is one of mine, proper service pages and contact details where customers expect them. House Clean Los Angeles (housecleanlosangeles.com) is another, set up so a first-time visitor feels confident enough to book.

If you like the design, I can build it out into a full site with proper service pages for each clean you offer. If not, keep the PDF as free ideas, no hard feelings either way.

Best,
Hassan
name: Pure Superior Cleaners
subject: 🧹 Alizabeth, one page and one review is the whole site
